1.note: channels + channel_members tables keyed by order id; data holds orderId and listingId

2.note: message kind order_card with JSONB data; order service PATCHes the row and Redis fans out message_updated

3.note: server-side regex mask (phone/email/off-platform payment) + reports table; no image or AI moderation

4.note: no vendor: a native build would need its own push pipeline and mailer; nothing provided

6.note: add_member inserts agent into channel_members; history query returns all earlier rows

7.note: read_state table + typing fan-out over Redis; attachments stored as BYTEA and served over HTTP
